review: Hallmark manual gate review plus browser and static checks
responsive: No horizontal overflow; controls remain readable; narrow navigation and disclosure labels checked
laptop_fold: At 1280x800, headline, description, primary action, and command example fit in the first screen
contrast: WCAG ratios checked for 14 foreground/background token pairs; body text and button labels exceed 4.5:1
interactions: Browser copy success and keyboard disclosure; isolated JavaScript checks for exact payload, loading, disabled, success, reset, rejected clipboard recovery, and API-unavailable fallback
resources: Page resources, document links, and section anchors resolve
fonts: Local WOFF2 files with bundled SIL OFL licenses
secondary_detector: Two advisory overused-font warnings; Space Grotesk and Inter retained as the explicitly selected Hallmark Cobalt pairing
runtime: No runtime source, shell integration, or installer changes made by this design task
relocation: Website, assets, brand guide, and design records moved into website/; 48 local references verified; JavaScript syntax and git diff whitespace checks passed
repository_gate: scripts/verify.sh: ALL GREEN (format, Clippy, unit tests, release build, all ten parity scenarios, color output, shell integration, read-only installs, interruption handling, portability)
